senses.definition: (uncountable) Erotic literature, art, decoration, or other such work.
examples: There's a fine line between erotica and pornography.

quotes.text: In fact, eighteenth-century British erotica has been the subject of unremitting attention for the last two decades.

quotes.text: Rather a principal avenue of traffic and distribution of eroticas is the social network of age-peers ([…]).

quotes.text: Some films advertised as minor eroticas are so much in demand by the paying public and these have overshadowed the value of a few seminars which seem to draw only the scholars and the film theorists.
